# Each write of each act, refused one at a time on a fresh page. A block: the write and the
# answer; the requests that followed it; each run of text that appeared on the page (container,
# innermost element); the sheet; the page's message state; any rejection the page left unhandled.

## Routing set: add SRC_2 (POST)
# writes, in order: PUT /api/processes/1/routing-nodes
### PUT /api/processes/1/routing-nodes  ←  400 {"error"} (writeError)
    then: GET /api/process-nodes · GET /api/processes/1/station-counters · GET /api/processes
    new text: .pd-sheet div.set-refusal: Not saved. The Edge refused it
    new text: .pd-sheet span.prov.dirty: Unsaved changes
    sheet: closed
    state: bar.refusal="Not saved. The Edge refused it"
    unhandled rejection: none
### PUT /api/processes/1/routing-nodes  ←  500, no body (chi Recoverer)
    then: GET /api/process-nodes · GET /api/processes/1/station-counters · GET /api/processes
    new text: .pd-sheet div.set-refusal: Not saved. Server error (500)
    new text: .pd-sheet span.prov.dirty: Unsaved changes
    sheet: closed
    state: bar.refusal="Not saved. Server error (500)"
    unhandled rejection: none
### PUT /api/processes/1/routing-nodes  ←  no answer (fetch rejects: TypeError "Failed to fetch")
    then: GET /api/process-nodes · GET /api/processes/1/station-counters · GET /api/processes
    new text: .pd-sheet div.set-refusal: Not saved. No answer from the server
    new text: .pd-sheet span.prov.dirty: Unsaved changes
    sheet: closed
    state: bar.refusal="Not saved. No answer from the server"
    unhandled rejection: none
### PUT /api/processes/1/routing-nodes  ←  session lapsed (303 to /login, 200 text/html, for it and every admin call after)
    then: GET /api/process-nodes · GET /api/processes/1/station-counters · GET /api/processes
    new text: #pd-stbody p.pd-note: This process has no positions yet: pick them under Screens and positions.
    new text: .pd-sheet div.set-refusal: Not saved.
    new text: .pd-sheet span.prov.dirty: Unsaved changes
    new text: .notice-root span.notice-text: Signed out
    new text: .notice-root a.notice-action: Sign in
    notice: error "Signed out" (sticky) · Sign in → /login?next=%2Fprocesses%3Fprocess%3D1
    sheet: closed
    state: bar.refusal="Not saved."
    unhandled rejection: none
